# ModalFooter

```ts
import { ModalFooter } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Modal Footer is the bottom action region of a modal dialog. It pairs an optional acknowledgement checkbox with a secondary and primary action. Use it with Modal Title and Modal Content; use a standard Button group outside a dialog.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checkbox` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Replacement for the leading checkbox slot. When supplied, all checkbox label and state props are ignored so consumers can compose another existing cake& control. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Replacement for the trailing action group. When supplied, all default action label, event, and disabled props are ignored. |
| `checkboxLabel` | `string` | `'Don’t remind me again'` | Visible label for the default Radix-wrapped Checkbox. |
| `checkboxChecked` | `boolean \| 'indeterminate'` | — | Controlled state for the default checkbox. Pair with onCheckboxCheckedChange; ignored when checkbox is supplied. |
| `defaultCheckboxChecked` | `boolean` | `false` | Initial state for the uncontrolled default checkbox. |
| `onCheckboxCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean \| 'indeterminate') => void` | — | Fired when the default checkbox changes state. |
| `checkboxDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the default checkbox. |
| `secondaryActionLabel` | `string` | `'Secondary'` | Visible label for the low-emphasis secondary action. |
| `onSecondaryAction` | `React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>` | — | Fired when the default secondary action is activated. |
| `secondaryActionDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the default secondary action. |
| `primaryActionLabel` | `string` | `'Primary'` | Visible label for the primary action. |
| `onPrimaryAction` | `React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>` | — | Fired when the default primary action is activated. |
| `primaryActionDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the default primary action. |

Also accepts all `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<ModalFooter onPrimaryAction={save} onSecondaryAction={close} />
<ModalFooter checkboxLabel="Don't show this again" onCheckboxCheckedChange={setDismissed} />
<ModalFooter primaryActionLabel="Delete" onPrimaryAction={remove} />
<ModalFooter checkbox={<Checkbox label="I understand" />} />
<ModalFooter actions={<Button>Continue</Button>} />
```

## Accessibility

- The default Checkbox uses Radix Checkbox semantics, keyboard handling, and its associated visible label.
- The default actions are native buttons with visible text labels and preserve the shared Button focus treatment.
- Keep the secondary action before the primary action so keyboard and visual hierarchy stay predictable.
- If replacing either slot, provide components with equivalent accessible names and keyboard behavior.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Place the secondary action before the primary action. | Reverse the action hierarchy. |
| Use the checkbox for a small acknowledgement or preference. | Put required form validation in the footer checkbox. |
| Compose existing cake& controls in replacement slots. | Rebuild local buttons or checkbox UI. |
| Let the parent dialog control width. | Add a fixed width to the footer itself. |
